protocol.nonce: ASCII decimal integer 1..2147483647; no signs or extra whitespace
protocol.input_bound: At most four batches of 32 input_event records per currently known verified phone descriptor
protocol.completion: Zero-time poll after all bounded reads; preceding key events and marker share the ordered output pipe

red_before_implementation.cause: Original apply_command treated DRAIN as invalid; queued phone power was not emitted before a marker

verification.check: Strict clang production build and both pure-policy/real-pipe test executables

scenarios: STATUS then phone POWER down/up then matching clear marker in actual stdout pipe
129-record queue exceeds128-record bound and returns busy; next drain emits remaining POWER before clear
Every known phone descriptor read, including last device slot
Wrong vendor/product never supplies a phone barrier or consumes its queued event
A disconnected phone denies clear even while another phone remains
HUP at exact batch limit returns unavailable
SYN_DROPPED stops helper without a clear acknowledgement
Closed old poll slot never consumes controller stdin
Malformed, overflowing, or nonpositive nonce disarms without marker
limits: No real evdev writes or injected hardware/phone events were attempted.
No actual device grab or controlled helper launch was performed during these tests.
A clear marker is a point-in-time snapshot of currently known verified phone descriptors; later keys or newly connected devices still require controller generation/mode/session rechecks.

root_passive_device_verification.deployment: Root backed up the previous native helper and atomically installed the candidate.
root_passive_device_verification.hardware_effects: No lease, grab, or TV action; passive lifecycle only.
